outcome: clinical presentations (amenorrhea, abdominal pain, bleeding per vaginum)
type of ectopic pregnancy (ampullary tubal ectopic)
cohort: 33 patients diagnosed with ectopic pregnancy and managed at ABVGMC, Vidisha.
finding: The incidence of ectopic pregnancy was 14.47/1000 deliveries, with pelvic inflammatory disease (60.60%) and previous cesarean section (24.24%) being the most common risk factors.
mod_finding: Previous cesarean section was identified as a significant risk factor for ectopic pregnancy, found in 24.24% of cases.
